title: A bounded worker shutdown budget
method: Synthetic sequential shutdown under a thirty-second grace period. Five plus eighteen plus four equals twenty-seven seconds; three remain. This assumes one bounded in-flight completion path and excludes unbounded external waits.
alt: A bounded worker shutdown budget: Stop admission 5 seconds, Finish in-flight work 18 seconds, Flush required state 4 seconds, Remaining margin 3 seconds. Illustrative inputs.
